items.desc_en: The hackers claim they have every agent's name, role, badge number and personal details including home address, phone numbers and spouse information.
items.desc_zh: 黑客声称他们拥有每个特工的姓名、角色、徽章号码和个人详细信息，包括家庭住址、电话号码和配偶信息。

items.title_en: Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn plan to begin Gaza's reconstruction
items.title_zh: 特朗普和平委员会公布24.5亿美元开始加沙重建计划
items.desc_en: The figure was announced during a meeting of the group's board at the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.
items.desc_zh: 这一数字是在纽约联合国大会期间召开的该组织董事会会议上宣布的。

items.title_en: UK survivor of Canadian poison seller says he exploited her despair
items.title_zh: 加拿大毒贩的英国幸存者称他利用了她的绝望
items.desc_en: Elisabeth Belien tells Kenneth Law's sentencing hearing she took the poison when she was just 23 years old.
items.desc_zh: 伊丽莎白·贝利恩 (Elisabeth Belien) 在肯尼思·劳 (Kenneth Law) 的量刑听证会上表示，她在 23 岁时服毒。

items.title_en: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault
items.title_zh: 哈维·韦恩斯坦因性侵犯被判入狱 15 年
items.desc_en: In court, Miriam Haley said the assault had a "devastating effect on my life and sense of security that may never go away".
items.desc_zh: 米里亚姆·哈利在法庭上表示，这次袭击“对我的生活和安全感造成了毁灭性影响，这种影响可能永远不会消失”。

items.title_en: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
items.title_zh: 伊朗总统告诉特朗普，伊朗永远不会“屈服”
items.desc_en: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.
items.desc_zh: 马苏德·佩泽什基安 (Masoud Pezeshkian) 在联合国发表挑衅性讲话之前，美国总统威胁称，如果不尽快达成和平协议，将“消灭”伊朗。

items.title_en: Poland accuses Russian military helicopter of violating its airspace
items.title_zh: 波兰指责俄罗斯军用直升机侵犯其领空
items.desc_en: Poland says the aircraft stayed in its skies for 42 seconds, forcing the Nato member to scramble its fighter jets.
items.desc_zh: 波兰表示，这架飞机在空中停留了 42 秒，迫使这个北约成员国紧急紧急起飞战斗机。
